01_baseline_reproduction: Reproduced benchmark pipelines on CICIDS2017 and IoTID20; compared tree models, balancing, feature selection and tuning. These are benchmark-split reproduction results, not new cross-network performance.
02_automl_and_resource_constraints: Implemented Pareto archives, feasibility-first search, repeated seeds and matched optimizer comparisons. Results do not establish consistent MOPSO superiority; measured compute and feasibility accompany quality metrics.
03_cross_dataset_transfer: Audited feature compatibility and tested source-to-target transfer. Per-capture false alarms and recall reveal failures that pooled scores can conceal.
04_temporal_adaptation: Compared frozen, periodic, drift-triggered and threshold-update policies on ordered traffic. Adaptation can recover detection while introducing capture-level false-alarm risk.
05_delayed_feedback_and_safeguards: Evaluated label delays, approval, rollback, recovery and deadline batching. The work measures harmful updates, missed attacks, switching and delivery cost; it does not establish a universally safe update controller.
06_budgeted_verification: Compared randomized disagreement review and decision-value allocation under label/reviewer budgets. No reliable general advantage was established; this direction was not promoted as a successful new algorithm.
07_generalization_and_context: Compared single- and multi-environment fitting, robust/group-aware controls and legitimate service/direction context. Later-period performance remains below the joint recall/FPR requirement.
08_behavioral_detection: Implemented bounded host histories and flow/behavioral/hybrid comparisons. Hybrid recall increases substantially on the full development replay, but false alarms exceed the target. Coverage and sensor-visibility controls are reported separately.
09_data_integrity_and_observability: Verified timestamps, cache alignment, feature conventions and label consistency; screened temporal data sources. Empirical feature-collision bounds are scoped to the audited family and fixed records, not population guarantees.
